title: Scroll bar partially overlaps uninstallable widgets after clearing search
line: After searching in the Widgets sidebar and clearing the search, the widget cards no longer slide under the scrollbar.
explanation: The grid's cell width was a third of the grid's width, and the grid gets narrower when the scrollbar appears. Typing or clearing a search hides or shows the scrollbar a moment after the results change, so the cell width changed while the cards were still sliding in with the add/displaced transitions; GridView kept the positions computed for the old width, so after clearing the cards sat 6 px per column too far right and the third column ran under the scrollbar (and during a search the second column overlapped the third). The cell width is now always computed as if the scrollbar were there, so it no longer changes when the scrollbar comes and goes.

commits.message:
WidgetExplorer: keep cell width the same when the scrollbar toggles

Filtering showed and hid the scrollbar, which changed the cell width
while the grid's add and displace transitions were still running, so
the cards ended up at the old positions and overlapped the scrollbar.

BUG: 447701

From 1775f321d36da3301dbb74f32766063b107485aa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] WidgetExplorer: keep cell width the same when the scrollbar
 toggles

Filtering showed and hid the scrollbar, which changed the cell width
while the grid's add and displace transitions were still running, so
the cards ended up at the old positions and overlapped the scrollbar.

BUG: 447701
---
 desktoppackage/contents/explorer/WidgetExplorer.qml | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/WidgetExplorer.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/WidgetExplorer.qml
index 3a4e1ac3e8..24abefb831 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/WidgetExplorer.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/WidgetExplorer.qml
@@ -292,7 +292,10 @@ PC3.Page {
         GridView {
             id: list
 
-            readonly property int effectiveWidth: width
+            // Always leave room for the scrollbar, so that the cells don't
+            // change size (and end up misplaced) when it appears or disappears
+            readonly property int effectiveWidth: scrollView.width
+                                                - scrollView.PC3.ScrollBar.vertical.width
                                                 - leftMargin
                                                 - rightMargin
 
--

media.caption: Master: after typing 'clock' and clearing it, the right card's border runs under the scrollbar
Fixed: after the same steps the card keeps its full border and a gap before the scrollbar
Master: while searching (no scrollbar) the cards are wider
Fixed: while searching the cards keep the same width, leaving the scrollbar's space empty

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in WidgetExplorer.qml that computes effectiveWidth from scrollView.width minus the vertical scrollbar's width at all times, preventing cellWidth from changing mid-transition when filtering toggles the scrollbar. This eliminates the third-column overlap under the scrollbar without forcing the scrollbar permanently visible (unlike the closed MR !2452) and avoids binding loops. Screenshots and verification cleanly confirm the fix across search/clear cycles.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in WidgetExplorer.qml that computes effectiveWidth from scrollView.width minus the vertical scrollbar's width at all times, preventing cellWidth from changing mid-transition when filtering toggles the scrollbar. This eliminates the third-column overlap under the scrollbar without forcing the scrollbar permanently visible (unlike the closed MR !2452) and avoids binding loops. Screenshots and verification cleanly confirm the fix across search/clear cycles.

The diagnosis is precise. The delayed scrollbar visibility changes the cell width while GridView's add/displaced transitions are running, and the items keep their old-width positions; the logged x values (160 step vs cellWidth 154) back this up. Always subtracting the scrollbar's width keeps the cell width constant, so the cause is removed rather than masked. It is a smaller UX trade-off than the abandoned always-on scrollbar: the only cost is a scrollbar-wide empty strip when there is no scrollbar, which after-2 shows to be unobtrusive. The before/after shots match the captions, and the commit message describes the one-line change accurately.
